title: Universal Resource Handle & Capability Contract
objective: Define the provider-neutral universal resource handle and capability contract without creating a second canonical asset ledger or beginning ARI-02 byte-identity work.
completion_summary: Implemented a typed provider-neutral resource handle with explicit media kind, source class, availability state, owning-domain reference, provider-reference boundary and evidence-backed use capabilities. Provider reference/control does not imply byte ownership, entitlement or extraction. Unknown/denied/revoked/missing/unsupported availability fails closed. ARI-01 creates no canonical asset ledger, byte identity, deduplication, ingestion runtime, provider networking, migration or UI.

matching_red.reason: Focused ARI-01 regression imported the intentionally absent ARI-01 production contract before GREEN implementation.

diagnostic_hypotheses: Application Validation Core active-family selector still named completed VTI at the ARI family transition.
The selector transition initially changed a schema version that the current repository-health validator intentionally freezes.
The new profile initially used feature_blame metadata inconsistent with the current Validation Core reason-code default.

boundaries: One reusable resource identity references an owning-domain entity and does not become a second canonical asset/content ledger.
Provider reference/control never implies content-byte ownership, entitlement, extraction, redistribution or commercial-use permission.
Unknown, denied, revoked, missing and unsupported states remain explicit and fail closed.
ARI-11 retains ownership of the expanded rights/license matrix.
ARI-02 byte identity/deduplication and all later ARI runtime work were not started.
Provider credentials, scraping/extraction, tester distribution and release/deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: ARI-02 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority; the next execution Continue may governed-start only ARI-02.
